    requires forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |lst| ==> |lst[i]| > 0 // All strings in the input list must be non-empty

    ensures |result| == CountEvenLengthStrings(lst) // The length of the result list is equal to the count of even length strings in lst
    ensures SortedByLengthAndAlphabetically(result) // The result list is sorted by length and alphabetically

// Helper function to count strings with even length
function CountEvenLengthStrings(lst: seq<string>): int
    decreases |lst|
    {
        if |lst| == 0 then
            0
        else if |lst[0]| % 2 == 0 then
            1 + CountEvenLengthStrings(lst[1..])
        else
            CountEvenLengthStrings(lst[1..])
    }

// Helper predicate to check if the list is sorted by length and alphabetically
predicate SortedByLengthAndAlphabetically(lst: seq<string>)
    reads lst
{
    forall i, j: int :: 0 <= i < j < |lst| ==> 
        (|lst[i]| < |lst[j>| || (|lst[i]| == |lst[j]| && lst[i] <= lst[j]))
}
```
